records.people: Greg Swart (Director, board of the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority)
records.move: from Managing Member and Chief Financial Officer of Farallon Capital Management LLC (2002-2019), and about twelve years at Goldman Sachs before that, to Director on the board of the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority
records.summary: The Authority's own board page says Swart was Managing Member and Chief Financial Officer of Farallon Capital Management LLC, which it describes as a global alternative asset management firm, from 2002 to 2019, and consulted for the firm after retiring from full-time work in 2019. It also records about twelve years at Goldman Sachs, where he ran a unit providing accounting and administration services to hedge funds within the prime brokerage business and was President of GS Financial Products from 1991 to 1996, after six years at Ernst & Young in New Zealand. The page gives no dates for his board service.
records.source_title: Director - The Board (Cayman Islands Monetary Authority)
records.quote: Farallon Capital Management LLC, a global alternative asset management firm

records.people: Dimitar Bogov (Vice Governor February 2007 to May 2011; Governor from 2011)
records.move: from chief economist of Stopanska Banka AD Skopje, a member of the NBG Group (2002 to January 2007), to Vice Governor of the National Bank of the Republic of Macedonia (February 2007 to May 2011) and then Governor
records.summary: The biography states that Bogov was chief economist at Stopanska Banka AD Skopje, described on the page as a member of the NBG Group, from 2002 until January 2007, responsible for economic and market analysis, business planning, management accounting and risk management, and that he then served as Vice Governor of the National Bank of the Republic of Macedonia from February 2007 to May 2011 before becoming Governor. The page also records four years in a senior position at what it calls the largest Macedonian bank, which it does not name, and earlier managerial posts at the State Statistical Office and the Ministry of Finance.
records.source_title: Dimitar Bogov - judge biography (Business Awards Europe)
records.quote: Chief economist in Stopanska Banka AD Skopje, member of NBG Group, from 2002 until January 2007

records.people: Dr Austin Mwape (Deputy Governor of Operations, Bank of Zambia)
records.move: from Deputy Governor of Operations at the Bank of Zambia to chairman of the board of directors of Stanbic Bank Zambia (from December 2016)
records.summary: The report states that Stanbic Bank Zambia welcomed Dr Austin Mwape as the new chairman of its board of directors, and identifies him as having served as deputy governor of operations at the Bank of Zambia; it gives no dates for the central bank role. Stanbic Bank Zambia's own announcement of his successor records that Mwape held the chair from December 2016 until 1 September 2020, and describes the bank as part of the Standard Bank Group, Africa's largest bank by assets.

records.people: Cheryl-Ann Lister (Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Bermuda Monetary Authority, 1999 to 2006)
records.move: from Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Bermuda Monetary Authority (1999 to 2006) to independent director of AXIS Capital Holdings Limited (announced 23 September 2008)
records.summary: The announcement states that AXIS Capital Holdings Limited appointed Cheryl-Ann Lister an independent director, as a Class II Director and a member of the Audit Committee, and that from 1999 through 2006 she served in both the Chairman and CEO roles at the Bermuda Monetary Authority. The page describes AXIS Capital Holdings Limited only as Bermuda-based; it does not state the company's line of business or who owns it, so the private-finance character of the employer rests on the governance language alone and would benefit from one confirming source.
records.source_title: Lister Joins AXIS Capital Board (Insurance Journal)
records.quote: From 1999 through 2006, she served in both the Chairman and CEO roles at the Bermuda Monetary Authority.
